products.name: Castelvetrano Olives
products.description: These vibrant green beauties are the best-selling olive in our antipasti case, and with good reason. Plump, juicy, and bursting with bright, buttery flavor, they make a perfect accompaniment to antipasti, tapas, or your next charcuterie board. Packed in brine and with their pits intact, they will satisfy any salty cravings while still feeling fresh, bright, and light.

products.name: DeLaurenti House Mix Olives
products.tagline: Made in our kitchen - marinated in herbs, garlic & citrus
products.description: Our House Olive Mix! Made in our kitchen, this is a delicious blend of country olives, marinated in a blend of herbs, garlic and citrus. Great for snacking and antipasti! Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: Lucques
products.tagline: The best olive you've never had!
products.description: The best olive you've never had. If you are one of the ones who has, then you know. Firm & buttery with just the right amount of acidity, this is the perfect snacking olive. Enjoy them out of the brine or drain the brine and lace them with your favorite olive oil, lemon zest & a sprig of herbs.

products.name: Greek Mix Olives
products.description: A handpicked blend of Kalamata, Mount Athos, and Mount Pelion olives. They are packed in brine with their pits intact, and seasoned with oregano and bay leaves. A very popular olive mix, this blend offers a fun variety of olives, and the seasoning is pleasant without being overbearing. These go great with feta, aged cheddar, hummus, or peppery salame.

products.name: Pitted Sicilian Olives
products.description: Kids can fit their little fingers in these babies and run around the house without the risk of poking themselves in the eye, you can use them in pasta, pizza, to make tapenade or drop in your Martini. Meaty, firm & mild, they are the skeleton key of olives.

products.name: Moroccan Oil Cured Olives
products.description: These unique olives are packed with flavor! Ripe black olives from Morocco’s Atlas Mountains are first dry-cured in salt, which concentrates their flavor and reduces any bitter notes. Then, the salt is removed, and the olives are soaked in oil. The result is a deeply flavorful, briny olive. They are drier in texture than most olives, but they retain a decidedly buttery characteristic.

products.name: Picholines with Preserved Lemon
products.description: Not all picholines are created equal. Villa Jerada sources great foods from Morocco & these olives are no exception. they are firm but creamy, with a wonderful citrus kick from the preserved lemon.

products.name: DeLaurenti Artichoke Spread
products.description: Enjoying a no frills artichoke spread and appreciating the finer things are not mutually exclusive. Correct, this is not the fanciest thing you will find at our store, but it is still one of the best. If you bring it to a friend's house for an appetizer, be prepared to have them ask you to bring it again and again. It is best enjoyed with grilled bread that has some crunch, or with Macrina's Apricot Nut Crostini. Want to know what's in it? Buy our cookbook! Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Bomba Spread
products.description: As seen on our classic Misto sandwich! This house spread is a blend of roasted onions, Mama Lil's Pickled Peppers & some DeLaurenti kitchen care. The sweetness of the onions mellows the bite of the peppers, making it good to put on almost anything! Great with all things cured meats...sandwiches, pizza, crostini & even in pasta!

products.name: DeLaurenti House Pate
products.description: Our ultra smooth House Pate is back with a new recipe! A house favorite for years! Serve with cornichons and a crusty Macrina baguette. Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Hummus
products.description: Our housemade Hummus - better than any mass produced grocery store brand, and a lot easier than making it yourself! We use Rancho Gordo garbanzo beans, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. Serve with raw or grilled vegetables, crostini, or with grilled chicken, tzatziki sauce, pita, cucumbers and tomatoes. Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Salmon Spread
products.description: Our housemade salmon spread! Made with smoked coho salmon collars, crème fraiche, cream cheese, and chives. Great on a breakfast bagel or served with crackers for an appetizer. Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Toum
products.description: Our housemade Lebanese style whipped garlic spread. Toum is the perfect marriage between garlic and lemon juice. Traditionally served with grilled meats and kebabs, this spread also works well on any sandwich, roasted vegetables, and even fast & easy garlic bread!

products.name: Incontro 'Nduja
products.tagline: This spread highlights the creamy, rich flavor of the Mangalitsa hogs
products.description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. Pronounced - (in-DOOJ-ah), this is the undisputed salumi champion from Calabria, Italy. Made with 100% Mangalitsa derived from the belly and shoulder meat, it is a spreadable, spicy/smoky salame. Naturally smoked and robust in color, it has the perfect balance of spice & sweetness. 'Nduja is the perfect salame to highlight the wonderful complexities of 100% grown Peperoncino di Calabria. Spread it on crostini, dot on your pizza or incorporate it into anything you would like to taste better!

products.name: Mamnoon Baba Ghanoush
products.tagline: Amazing spread from the Seattle institution!
products.description: Mamnoon on Capital Hill is one of the best spots in the city. The flavors and the atmosphere are totally unique in Seattle. So too is their Baba Ganoush. Made with smoked eggplant, tahini & garlic, it's intense smoky flavor makes for a great sauce for grilled meats of all kinds.

products.name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meatballs
products.description:
Ok, these are the real deal - created and produced in the comfort of our kitchen upstairs at the store. Approximately 6 meatballs per pound, FULLY COOKED and ready to go! Your only job is choosing the number of meatballs & deciding whether you want them lightly covered in sauce or plain. Want more than twelve? Just choose the number, a quantity & multiply it! Ie: 12 meatballs, qty of 2 = 24 meatballs! Want them swimming in sauce instead of just covered? Order more DeLaurenti Marinara to go with it!

As an ode to Nate's Nonna, we love to serve 3 meatballs in a bowl with red sauce, Reggiano & a piece of grilled bread. This was the only thing that would keep him and his cousins from tearing the house apart. They lined up and were dispensed a sampler meatball in sauce and a piece of bread for dipping. Receiving it was committing to good behavior. They are great served as such, piled into a soft roll, or, of course combined with some marinara & tossed with spaghetti! If you would like, we include enough sauce to cover. You might want to order another container of marinara!

products.name: DeLaurenti Smoked Trout Spread
products.description: Take your fish spread game to the next level with this smoked trout spread! Start with delicately smoked Girard & Dominque trout, add a combination of Farmer's Cheese, sour cream, garlic, herbs & lemon. Just add crostini or crunchy crackers!

products.name: Grilled Artichokes with Stems
products.description: Grown, picked, grilled and marinated in Italy and sent right to your doorstep. Enjoy them as an 'artichoke pop' or let them provide some dramatic presentation on your next antipasti spread! We know what you're thinking...those things look good, but they have to be fibery and tough like every other artichoke with a stem that I've ever eaten. Think again...they are super tender and they taste just like they look...really good!

products.name: Mamnoon Muhammara
products.tagline: Amazing spread from the Seattle institution!
products.description: Mamnoon on Capital Hill is one of the best spots in the city. The flavors and the atmosphere are totally unique in Seattle. Speaking of unique...Muhammara. If you aren't familiar, this is a spread made from walnuts, pepper paste, cumin, pomegranate molasses & bread crumbs. With all it has going on, it is best enjoyed simply with warm pita!

products.name: DeLaurenti Cherry Peppers with Cheese
products.description: The other peppers in the antipasti case! Red hot(ish) Calabrian chili peppers are stuffed with cheese, so you don't have to! Add vibrant color to your antipasti spread or your picnic. No need to think about how to use them, just eat them!

products.name: DeLaurenti Dolmas
products.description: The DeLaurenti antipasti case classic! Perhaps the best deal in the Market for a quick snack or as an addition to your antipasti spread. What are they? Good question: Tender grape leaves stuffed with rice, sauteed onions & herbs. Bite size and made for walking & eating!

products.name: DeLaurenti Gigandes
products.description: These beans have been a deli favorite for years. Meaty, but creamy in texture, they are marinated in oil & vinegar and combined with ribbons of sweet peppers. Great as an addition to your antipasti platter, on a salad or right out of the container!

products.name: DeLaurenti Marinated Eggplant
products.description: As seen in our antipasti case! Fresh market eggplant is sliced thick, roasted & marinated in a combination of olive oil, wine vinegar, garlic & herbs. Great enjoyed as-is alongside the rest of your antipasti spread, on a salad, pizza or a sandwich!

products.name: DeLaurenti Peperonata
products.description: If you have these in your fridge, you have options. Made in our kitchen upstairs, these are handcut strips of whole sweet red & yellow peppers are marinated in oil/vinegar, garlic, herbs & spices. Not spicy, just delicious. They are great alongside cured meats, on a sausage or tuna sandwich or on pizza. Why do it yourself when we've already done it for you?

products.name: DeLaurenti Pepper Delights
products.description: These pepper shooters have been a DeLaurenti favorite for many years, attracting people from far and wide to come to our store to get their fix. They are crunchy, not too spicy green cherry peppers stuffed with prosciutto and provolone. Quarter or half them and add them to your antipasto tray, or eat them whole right from the container! There are approximately 10 to 12 peppers per pound.

products.name: DeLaurenti Pickled Red Onions
products.description: Made upstairs in our kitchen, these sweet & sour onions are the perfect accompaniment to everything from pate to tuna carpaccio or tuna salad!

products.name: DeLaurenti Roasted Garlic
products.description: Roasting garlic is easy, but let's face it, it's a LOT better when someone does it for you! Well, we have so you can stop thinking to yourself that you already should have. Your just a few clicks away from having freshely roasted garlic on your next pizza, smeared on crostini & folded into your mayo for roasted garlic aoli!

products.name: DeLaurenti Roasted Tomatoes
products.description: Pound for pound one of the most flavorful items in our case! Bright red roasted & marinated tomatoes add a splash of color and flavor to your antipasti spread, or complete your pizza or panini vision. So many uses! One of the most versitile ingredients in the shop!

products.name: Seattle Caviar Paddlefish, 1oz
products.description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Paddlefish, species polydon spathula, is found in the Yellowstone River and throughout the Mississippi River system. This prehistoric species produces a natural caviar and is very similar in appearance to Caspian Sevruga. It has a mild flavor and a medium bead size.

products.name: Seattle Caviar Ikura, 2oz
products.description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Chum Salmon are specifically prized for its roe and Salmon Caviar is often referred to as "Ikura" the Japanese term for caviar.

products.name: Bahia de la Concha White Boquerones
products.description: Bahia de la Concha is renowned worldwide for the quality of their semi-preserved white anchovies. Also known as "Boquerones" Bahia de la Concha's extra large, plump, hand filtered white anchovies are preserved in white wine vinegar, sunflower oil, garlic and parsley. These umami-rich fish are freshly caught from the Cantabrian Sea in Northern Spain, then filleted and packed by hand. Unctuous, sweet, and bright, add them to your next charcuterie board or have as a mid-day snack over some crusty bread with nduja.

products.name: Bottarga, 100g to 130g
products.description: Bottarga is a delicious product derived from mullet roe. It is extracted, salted and air-dried naturally, using traditional Sardinian methods. Referred to as Italian Caviar, this fish roe is extracted with its membrane still intact, is lightly pressed, and cured and dried in the sun. Strictly from Sardinia region this Bottarga is semi-dried for a better consistency and is best enjoyed grated over pasta dishes, eggs or grilled bread.

products.name: Rougie Duck Foie Gras, 80g
products.description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy its full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half-inch-thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

products.name: Rougie Mousse Royale
products.description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.
